items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: George William I liked to work with him

ctx.x: He traveled up to Mississippi for a while, with little brother Montgomery and another group.
Yeah, he didn't stay here much. George was very seldom, I mean, you'd catch him now and the next thing you know he's gone, like Danny Barker, you know. They'd go out and just move abroad.
Yeah, we never think much about Danny Barker, he's been gone so many years. Do you remember when he played around here?
